meta.title: Blue Mountain Farms
meta.description: Certified Blue Zone organics from the Blue Mountains of Guanacaste — harvested Monday & Thursday, delivered Tuesday & Friday.

hero.title: Harvested at dawn. At your door in eighteen hours.
hero.body: The freshest organics from Costa Rica’s Blue Zone — create a weekly box or order à la carte.

rhythm.title: Harvested Mon & Thu at dawn
rhythm.body: We pick when produce is at peak — not when a warehouse schedule says so.

rhythm.title: Packed & cooled the same morning
rhythm.body: Hygienic, thoughtful packing that keeps nutrients and crunch locked in.

rhythm.title: Delivered Tue & Fri
rhythm.body: Refrigerated routes across Guanacaste. Field to kitchen in about eighteen hours.

growers.name: Blue Mountain Farms

growers.name: Neighbor growers

wholesale.title: For restaurants & hotels
wholesale.body: Standing orders, weekly availability lists, and refrigerated delivery for kitchens that care about provenance.
